Columns: toolres_mm = steps whose tool result differs from the logged one; action_mm = parsed action differs; perr_cat_mm /
perr_msg_mm = parse error category / message differs; state_mm = environment state after the step differs; repair_mm = repair
flag or repaired text differs; verdict_mm = our PASS/FAIL differs from the logged verdict (the run.log line where the run has
one, otherwise the per-task matrix, which is the author's replay); tag_mm(mx) = failure tag set differs from the matrix;
mxcols_mm = matrix steps / trajectory_success columns differ; logline_mm = whole run.log line differs (pass/fail mark, tags,
trajectory summary with argument values); agg_mm = run-level numbers differ from summary.json or the run.log footer.
Runs without a run.log (21): their per-task verdict is the author's replay, so it is compared with the matrix, and the
run-time summary.json (pass count, inconclusive count, success rate, repair count, tag histogram incl. timeouts) is the
independent record we hold them to.
